viktoria.help.title: Project Vika: main commands
viktoria.help.summon: /vika summon, or say "I feel lonely" in chat, or use Vika's Heart
viktoria.help.orders: /vika follow | stay | wander | come | stop | sleep | wakeup
viktoria.help.fetch: /vika fetch <item> [count] [queue], or say "bring me some bread"
viktoria.help.tasks: /vika chop | harvest | cook [radius], /vika queue list | clear | remove <n>
viktoria.help.jobs: /vika job lumberjack | farmer | cook [radius], /vika job stop
viktoria.help.chests: /vika chest <purpose> while looking at a chest, /vika chest list
viktoria.help.chat: Talk to her in chat within 64 blocks. Chain orders with "then". Press K for her menu.
viktoria.release.confirm: This cannot be undone: %s will leave for good and drop her belongings. Type /vika release confirm to go ahead.
viktoria.upload.quota: You already keep %s files of this kind on the server. Replace one of them (same file name) or ask an admin to remove one.
viktoria.upload.bbmodel_only: Only .bbmodel files can be sent from here (they hold their textures). Put .geo.json models in the server folder config/projectvika/models.
viktoria.menu.language.hint: UI and dialogue follow your Minecraft language (English / Russian).
